notes: Added missing core logic hardening, external link validation, and API resilience stories for FEAT-4.

change_log.value: Add NPI response mapping and normalization logic
Add URL validation and enrichment for external links
Add error handling, retries, and timeout controls for NPI API

FEAT-4-STORY-43.title: Normalize NPI Registry Response to Internal Provider Schema
FEAT-4-STORY-43.description: Implement transformation logic in provider_detail_service to map raw NPI Registry API responses into the standardized provider detail schema, including handling missing or inconsistent fields.

FEAT-4-STORY-44.title: Validate and Enrich External Provider Links
FEAT-4-STORY-44.description: Integrate URL validation and correction for state medical board and research links using existing URL guardian to ensure all outbound links are live, safe, and properly formatted.

FEAT-4-STORY-45.title: Implement NPI API Error Handling and Retry Logic
FEAT-4-STORY-45.description: Add robust error handling in provider_detail_service including timeout management, retry with backoff, and graceful degradation when NPI Registry is unavailable.
